newsitem.title: UK: Ugland in $160 mln reverse takeover.
newsitem.headline: Ugland in $160 mln reverse takeover.

text.p: Shipping firm Ugland International Holdings Plc said it is to buy vehicle carrier interests from the Ugland family for some $160 million in a reverse takeover.

Ugland will buy the Ugland family's entire vehicle carrying interests, which comprise a 50 percent stake in HUAL, a Norwegian-based shipping firm, a 100 percent ownership of seven vehicle carriers and a 50 percent interest in two others.
Ugland may also have to make a deferred payment of $40 million depending on net income from the assets under the deal.

Ugland will pay for the acquisition with bank loans and the issue of new Ugland shares via a placing and open offer. Ugland family members expect to take up enough shares to at least maintain their interest in the enlarged group. The family currently has 36.87 percent of Ugland's share capital.
Ugland's existing businesses involve ownership and operation of refrigerated, vehicle carrier and feeder container vessels, ship management and repairs.
Ugland's pretax profit in the six months to June 30 was 3.2 million stg.
The company said in view of the size of the deal the London Stock Exchange has classified it as a reverse takeover.
